headline: Hacktron reports model-assisted exploit chain reaching OpenAI employee accounts
summary: In a September 13, 2026 report, Hacktron says three researchers used Claude Opus 4.8 and Opus 5 during a July security-research effort that chained a Discourse HEIF image-upload vulnerability with an OpenAI single-sign-on flaw. Hacktron reports that the chain reached employee ChatGPT/Codex accounts and that a human-directed Codex session opened a harmless pull request in an internal repository; it says testing stopped after the proof and OpenAI paid a bounty for the OpenAI-side finding. Discourse's July 28 security advisory independently confirms remote code execution through malformed HEIF uploads and credits Hacktron as reporter, but does not establish the OpenAI identity or account-access portion. The model's contribution and the reported impact remain first-party claims; skilled human guidance remained part of the work.
